profile.summary: A tuition-free public charter school in Oakland, California, that runs a French dual-immersion program for students in transitional kindergarten through 8th grade. Students learn in both French and English. It is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

review.notes: The school's site and ProPublica both show Francophone Charter School of Oakland, EIN 46-4356231, a 501(c)(3) in Oakland with OUSD as authorizer, which fits an in-lieu Prop 39 facilities agreement via the Office of Charter Schools. All profile fields (address, phone, generic contact email, grades TK-8, French dual immersion) are confirmed and the summary is neutral.
